---
title: "Analysis 1: linear model per gene (tumor vs normal)"
format: html
---

## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("ggrepel")
```

## Load data

The wide file has about 30,000 gene columns, so each line is longer than
the default read buffer. The buffer is increased before reading.

```{r}
#| message: false
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = "5000000")

dat <- read_tsv("../data/03_dat_aug.tsv.gz")

probemap <- read_tsv(
  "../data/_raw/gencode.v36.annotation.gtf.gene.probemap"
) |>
  select(gene = id,
         symbol = gene)
```

## Paired or unpaired?

How many patients have both a tumor and a normal sample. If 20 or more we go
with the paired model.

With exactly 2 samples per patient, `log2_expr ~ condition + patient` is in
practice a paired t-test written as a linear model. The patient term removes
the differences between patients, so the condition effect is estimated from
the within-patient differences.
(This should probably be moved to 04_describe.qmd later.)

```{r}
paired_patients <- dat |>
  count(patient) |>
  filter(n == 2)

n_paired <- nrow(paired_patients)
n_paired

use_paired <- n_paired >= 20
```

## Condition as factor

normal is the reference level, so the coefficient is tumor minus normal.

```{r}
dat <- dat |>
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("normal", "tumor")))

if (use_paired) {
  dat <- dat |>
    semi_join(paired_patients, by = "patient")
}
```

## Long format

```{r}
dat_long <- dat |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("ENSG"),
               names_to = "gene",
               values_to = "log2_expr")
```

Test run on 100 random genes first. Set `test_run` to FALSE to run on all
genes (remember to do this before the final render).

```{r}
test_run <- FALSE

if (test_run) {
  set.seed(42)
  some_genes <- dat_long |>
    distinct(gene) |>
    slice_sample(n = 100)

  dat_long <- dat_long |>
    semi_join(some_genes, by = "gene")
}
```

## Nest by gene

```{r}
dat_nested <- dat_long |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  nest()

dat_nested
```

## One model per gene

```{r}
if (use_paired) {
  model_formula <- log2_expr ~ condition + patient
} else {
  model_formula <- log2_expr ~ condition
}

dat_nested <- dat_nested |>
  mutate(model_object = map(data,
                            ~ lm(model_formula, data = .x)))
```

## Tidy the models

```{r}
dat_nested <- dat_nested |>
  mutate(model_object_tidy = map(model_object,
                                 ~ tidy(.x,
                                        conf.int = TRUE,
                                        conf.level = 0.95)))
```

## Unnest and keep the condition term

```{r}
lm_results <- dat_nested |>
  unnest(model_object_tidy) |>
  filter(term == "conditiontumor") |>
  select(gene, estimate, std.error, statistic,
         p.value, conf.low, conf.high) |>
  ungroup()
```

## Add gene symbols

```{r}
lm_results <- lm_results |>
  left_join(probemap, by = "gene") |>
  relocate(symbol, .after = gene)
```

## Multiple testing

```{r}
lm_results <- lm_results |>
  mutate(q_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
         is_significant = case_when(q_value < 0.05 ~ "yes",
                                    TRUE ~ "no"))
```

Since the expression values are log2(count+1), the estimate can be read
directly as the log2 fold change of tumor vs normal. E.g. an estimate of 2
means about 4 times higher expression in tumor.

## Direction of change

Up / Down if q < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1, otherwise NS.

```{r}
lm_results <- lm_results |>
  mutate(direction = case_when(q_value < 0.05 & estimate > 1 ~ "Up",
                               q_value < 0.05 & estimate < -1 ~ "Down",
                               TRUE ~ "NS"))

lm_results
```

Check for q values that are rounded to 0 (they would give Inf in the
volcano plot).

```{r}
lm_results |>
  filter(q_value == 0) |>
  count()
```

## Save results

```{r}
write_tsv(lm_results, "../data/05_dat_lm_results.tsv.gz")

lm_summary <- lm_results |>
  count(direction)

lm_summary

write_tsv(lm_summary, "../results/05_n_up_down.tsv")
```

## Volcano plot

Label the 10 significant genes with the lowest q value. If a gene has no
symbol the Ensembl ID is used instead.

```{r}
top_genes <- lm_results |>
  filter(direction != "NS") |>
  arrange(q_value) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

volcano_dat <- lm_results |>
  mutate(label = case_when(gene %in% pull(top_genes, gene) ~
                             coalesce(symbol, gene),
                           TRUE ~ ""))

volcano_plot <- volcano_dat |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate,
             y = -log10(pmax(q_value, 1e-300)),
             colour = direction,
             label = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Down" = "steelblue",
                                 "NS" = "grey70",
                                 "Up" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change (tumor vs normal)",
       y = "-log10(q value)",
       colour = "",
       title = "Differential expression, tumor vs normal") +
  theme_minimal()

volcano_plot

ggsave("../results/05_volcano.png", volcano_plot, width = 7, height = 5)
```

## Forest plot of top genes

```{r}
forest_plot <- top_genes |>
  mutate(symbol = coalesce(symbol, gene),
         symbol = fct_reorder(symbol, estimate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = symbol)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
                orientation = "y",
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change (95% CI)",
       y = "",
       title = "Top 10 significant genes") +
  theme_minimal()

forest_plot

ggsave("../results/05_forest.png", forest_plot, width = 6, height = 4)
```
